text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weigh-in! In this corner is an entry from your humble announcer, who also happens to be the judge. So the owner keeps the scorecard on this one, folks. There's no realism score yet and nothing to compare it to. But the wardrobe got real work. That sportsuit now rides the skin's own bone weights instead of seventeen coarse groups. It took me this long to dress myself properly! Standing one point seven three meters tall, a patient counter-striker in terracotta. Introducing... CLAUDE!
